comment: Great professor. Very passionate about what she teaches and very knowledgable as well. She is so approachable and kind - she really wants to see you succeed. She gave great lectures and was always open to students thoughts/feedback/questions.

Dr. Jacob is new at UR and a really great professor. I took her new PSYC299 Parental Brain class and I really enjoyed it. She is a really caring professor and clearly passionate about what she does which makes the class that much more interesting. She gives around 3 Big Quizzes, a midterm, and final, and a few little papers in between. She is great
